hints.title: Seat Parity Requirement
hints.text: If the total number of seats is zero or odd, it is impossible to divide the corridor into sections of two seats each.

hints.title: Identify Partition Gaps
hints.text: Every partition boundary must be placed between the second seat of one section and the first seat of the next section.

hints.title: Product Rule of Counting
hints.text: For each pair of consecutive sections, the number of valid divider locations equals the index difference between the two adjacent seats.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all possible divider configurations generates exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single linear pass to record seat indices takes O(N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply combinatorics product rule between adjacent 2-seat blocks.
